title: High-resolution map of plastid encoded polymerase binding patterns demonstrates a major role of transcription in chloroplast gene expression
authors: V. Miguel Palomar; Sarah Jaksich; Sho Fujii; Jan Kuciński; Andrzej T. Wierzbicki
one_liner_zh: 该文用ptChIP-seq绘制叶绿体编码RNA聚合酶（PEP）的全基因组DNA结合图谱，属于蛋白质-DNA互作研究，但聚焦叶绿体非典型TF体系，且方法为实验测序而非AI或物理模拟，与课题方法轴不符。
abstract: Plastids are endosymbiotic organelles containing their own genomes, which are transcribed by two types of RNA polymerases. One of those enzymes is a bacterial-type, multi-subunit polymerase encoded by the plastid genome. The plastid encoded RNA polymerase (PEP) is required for efficient expression of genes encoding proteins involved in photosynthesis. Despite the importance of PEP, its DNA binding locations have not been studied on the genome-wide scale at high resolution. We established a highly specific approach to detect the genome-wide pattern of PEP binding to chloroplasts DNA using ptChIP-seq. We found that in mature Arabidopsis thaliana chloroplasts, PEP has a complex DNA binding pattern with preferential association at genes encoding rRNA, tRNA, and a subset of photosynthetic proteins. Sigma factors SIG2 and SIG6 strongly impact PEP binding to a subset of tRNA genes and have more moderate effects on PEP binding throughout the rest of the genome. PEP binding is commonly enriched on gene promoters, around transcription start sites. Finally, the levels of PEP binding to DNA are correlated with the levels of RNA accumulation, which allowed estimating the quantitative contribution of transcription to RNA accumulation.
abstract_zh: 质体是内共生细胞器，含有自身基因组，由两种类型的RNA聚合酶转录。其中一种酶是由质体基因组编码的细菌型多亚基聚合酶。质体编码的RNA聚合酶（PEP）对于编码参与光合作用蛋白质的基因的高效表达是必需的。尽管PEP的重要性，其DNA结合位点尚未在高分辨率下进行全基因组规模的研究。我们建立了一种高度特异性的方法，利用ptChIP-seq检测PEP与叶绿体DNA结合的全基因组模式。我们发现，在成熟的拟南芥叶绿体中，PEP具有复杂的DNA结合模式，优先与编码rRNA、tRNA及部分光合作用蛋白的基因相关联。Sigma因子SIG2和SIG6强烈影响PEP与部分tRNA基因的结合，并对PEP在基因组其余部分的结合产生较为温和的影响。PEP结合通常富集于基因启动子区域，围绕转录起始位点。最后，PEP与DNA结合的水平与RNA积累水平相关，这使我们能够估算转录对RNA积累的定量贡献。
